purpose: Freeze provenance and venue semantics before acquiring price-bearing inputs; this is not an economic preregistration or source certificate.

metadata_requests.query_contract: Explicit Spot category; explicit CMC listing_status; no credentials, duplicate parameters, price/quote/latest-listings endpoints or silently assumed full coverage.

historical_collection_envelope.selection_basis: Fixed historical envelope before inspecting candidate economic outcomes; no prices acquired at this stage.

protected_study.operation: No price acquisition, loading, features, labels or scoring in protected interval; this intake additionally denies ALL price/return requests.

source_requirements.alignment: Verify dates and numeric asset IDs across every matrix, not only the close vector.
source_requirements.alternatives: A documented alternative real source requires an explicit versioned derivative/provenance mapping; do not claim original-paper replication.
source_requirements.volume: Original volume is global dollar-notional. Freeze source, base versus quote-notional units and USD versus USDT; no silent substitution.
source_requirements.authenticity: Hashes prove integrity, not availability at a historic decision. Acquired-now/restated history stays labelled as such.

asset_mapping.primary_identity: Numeric CMC ID or explicitly versioned alternative provider ID, plus chain/contract or native-asset evidence
asset_mapping.join: Effective-dated, evidence-backed crosswalk; symbol/name match alone is insufficient
asset_mapping.history: Current active/inactive map or current Trading status cannot establish old listing, delisting, stablecoin classification or lot constraints. Keep delisted assets and unresolved entries; no hindsight survivor filter.

venue_execution_contract.spot_quantity_increment: basePrecision; validate semantics for observed schema/vintage, never copy derivative qtyStep unconditionally
venue_execution_contract.spot_notional_minimum: minOrderAmt; current Spot minOrderQty is deprecated
venue_execution_contract.spot_order_units: Explicit marketUnit and order_type; market-buy defaults to quote value, never infer base-quantity semantics
venue_execution_contract.order_limits: Selected order-type maximum quantity, base/quote increments, price tick, partial-fill/cancel behavior and rules validity need dedicated adapter tests
venue_execution_contract.fees: Bybit fee is charged in purchased asset: a buy reduces received base inventory, a sell reduces received quote. Fee rate remains a frozen scenario unless account evidence establishes it.
venue_execution_contract.existing_wallet_limit: Frozen technical v1 uses a generic quote-cash buy fee and full assumed fills. It is not a complete Bybit Spot adapter; native test success does not certify venue fidelity.
venue_execution_contract.historical_rules: Require effective-dated, independently evidenced rules; no backdating current metadata or inventing valid_until.

observed_source_status.bybit_mainnet_public_metadata: HTTP403 on Laptop2, one request; no proxy/region/domain workaround attempted
observed_source_status.raw_filenames: No matching originals in scratch inventory or the bounded Laptop2 E:/NEXUS-QA and F:/NEXUS-Tools/ChatCLI filename inventory; not a claim about all user storage.
observed_source_status.coinmarketcap_keyless_map: Official documentation verified; no response acquired and no actual historical source authenticated.

next_evidence_gate: Obtain a permitted real source package and its provenance/coverage/IDs without protected prices
Validate historical economic-asset/Bybit-Spot identity and release/rule vintages
Implement and test exact purchased-asset fee, order units, limits and partial-fill adapter before venue feasibility
Freeze separate economic development/evaluation protocol before any price-bearing load
